title: Concept: Overly open CORS (nginx) — review required
description: In nginx, add_header Access-Control-Allow-Origin *; accepts origins beyond the application's own, so other sites can read responses that carry the user's session. The remedy is an explicit list of trusted origins (a mapped origin variable), without credentials for wildcards.
applicability: nginx API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
